# Synthetic P66A Encyclopedia fixture

This directory contains contributor-authored text and metadata only. It models
one ship, one factional mission, and one system topic closely enough to exercise
the current P66A source parser and binder. It contains no original game prose,
artwork, raw resource bytes, local paths, or generated runtime packs.

`source.json.manifest.json` follows the staging tool's existing sidecar naming.
Its source-DLL digests are synthetic lowercase-hex identities.

Larger boundary cases are generated in tests instead of checked in.
